test_title: PYST 08: SSC JE EE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the sister of B', and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the husband of B'.

How is F related to Z if 'D ÷ F × G ÷ H + N - Z'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Sister
 Husband
 
 

 

Given: D ÷ F × G ÷ H + N - Z

It means: D is the Husband of F, F is the Sister of G, G is the Husband of H, H is the Mother of N, and N is the Brother of Z.

F is the sister of G, who is the husband of H. H is the mother of N, and N is the brother of Z. Therefore, F is the sister of Z's father.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b74faf9658500645ba6e0e74092605dd02c118f9f964286b43adc877e2902bfe.png] 

Hence, F is Z's Father's Sister.
